title: Product Manager – Web
description:
Role Mission

Own and evolve Expanish’s website as a core digital product and primary direct sales channel , improving the end-to-end user experience and driving higher conversion and revenue through product strategy, data, and continuous experimentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as Product Owner of expanish.com, with clear business and user goals
  • Define the product vision for the website aligned with company growth objectives
  • Analyze the full user journey: discovery → consideration → decision → payment
  • Identify user pain points and product opportunities impacting conversion and revenue
  • Define and prioritize a product roadmap focused on UX, flows, pricing, and checkout
  • Lead discovery and experimentation initiatives (A/B tests, prototypes, validation)
  • Collaborate closely with design, engineering, and marketing teams to deliver improvements
  • Ensure product decisions are data-informed and outcome-driven
  • Track performance through clear KPIs and share insights with stakeholders

Success Metrics

  • Website conversion rate
  • Revenue generated through the website
  • Share of direct (self-booking) sales
  • Drop-off rates at critical funnel steps
  • Revenue per visitor

Ideal Profile

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager on digital products
  • Proven track record working on conversion, monetization, or growth-related initiatives
  • Experience with web products, e-commerce, marketplaces, or SaaS platforms
  • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with data and experimentation
  • Ability to balance user needs with business impact
  • Autonomous, structured, and outcome-oriented

Nice To Have (not Required)

  • Experience owning a website as a product
  • Experience with pricing, checkout, or payment flows
  • Background in B2C and/or international products
  • Interest in education, travel, or global digital platforms

Why Expanish

At Expanish, we help people from all over the world learn Spanish by living the language , combining high-quality education with immersive cultural experiences.

We are a fast-growing, international education company with students from dozens of countries and a strong digital presence. Our website plays a critical role in how students discover us, choose their programs, and book their experience.

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Own and shape a high-impact digital product with direct influence on revenue
  • Work on a global B2C product with real users and meaningful outcomes
  • Make data-driven decisions and see the impact of your work quickly
  • Collaborate with a cross-functional, international team
  • Help scale a mission-driven product that connects education, travel, and culture

If you enjoy building products that balance user value and business impact , and want to see your work reflected directly in growth, this role is for you.

Open to candidates based in Argentina / Remote

title: Site Contract Manager - CRO
description:
Join Medpace at our Buenos Aires office! Our clinical operations activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office based Site Contract Manager to join our LatAm Site Contracts team within the Clinical Operations department. This position will report to the LatAm Senior Contract Manager and will play a key role in the study start‑up and clinical trial management processes at Medpace. The Contract Manager will play a key role in advancing the start‑up of our projects. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

  • Act as Contract Study Lead on allocated studies with active responsibility for the performance of the contract team assigned to the study, acting as a primary point of contact between Sponsor and study teams, determining site contract processes, delegating duties to staff, and providing functional oversight of site contract and budget negotiations;
  • Create project‑specific site contract documents, including study templates;
  • Review contract queries that fall outside of agreed parameters escalated by Contract Specialists;
  • Ensure Contract staff provide timely and accurate budget and contract review and execution, as well as meaningful updates in ClinTrak;
  • Facilitate clear communication, evaluation, and reporting of ongoing contract negotiations to study teams (e.g., Clinical Trial Management, Regulatory Submissions), ensuring that timelines are met, delays are managed effectively, and study team and Sponsor concerns are addressed as appropriate;
  • Provide contract support and advice related to site payments, site contracts, and other related documents and vendor contracts, identifying potential contractual issues, addressing, escalating and/or resolving such in order to minimize contractual risk to the organization;
  • Support in the development and implementation of contract management and compliance initiatives;
  • Line manage local or remote staff where applicable, including recruitment, training and development, and functional oversight of staff; and
  • May be responsible for other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in the area of Business, Life Sciences, or Law, with 4 years of clinical research industry experience, in clinical operations with contract management experience, or Juris Doctorate/Advanced education in the field of law and 2 years of clinical research industry experience with contract management experience;
  • Experience with LATAM Site Contracts required; US project experience preferred;
  • Broad knowledge of clinical trial conduct, standards of Good Clinical Practice, and applicable regulations and laws;
  • Demonstrated knowledge and ability to review and revise contracts for legal implications; and
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully motivate and collaborate with internal and external study team members, including Contract Specialists without direct reporting relationship.
  • Fluency in English
  • We kindly ask to submit CV in English
\

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full‑service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I‑IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti‑viral and anti‑infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of a team dedicated to supporting the development of ground‑breaking drugs and devices. Our employees provide hope for those living with debilitating diseases. We invite you to be a part of something that is impacting millions of people around the globe while enjoying a competitive total compensation and benefits package and internal growth opportunities.

Organic Growth:

Medpace is continuing to grow in all areas globally and has built an expansive research campus at its headquarters in Cincinnati, OH. In 2020, Medpace opened a new seven story building that is approximately 250,000 SQFT. In total, the headquarter's campus includes five buildings and approximately 600,000 SQFT. The company also has expanding office locations in Dallas, TX and Denver, CO.

Perks (vary by location and position)

  • Campus walking paths
  • Company‑sponsored social and wellness events
  • Official Sponsor of FC Cincinnati
  • Hybrid work‑from‑home options and flexible work schedule
  • On‑site Market Place
  • Free and covered parking
  • Discounts for local businesses
  • On campus restaurants and banks coming soon

Awards

  • Medpace historically named a Top Cincinnati Workplace by the Cincinnati Enquirer
  • Recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Mid‑size Companies in 2021
  • Medpace ranks amongst top CROs for site ratings across all 10 important attributes including CRA training, preparation & organization, accessibility of staff, open communication, and ensuring timely drug availability
  • Continually recognized with CRO Leadership Awards from Life Science Leader magazine based on expertise, quality, capabilities, reliability, and compatibility
  • Ranked in the top 10 on the 2021 LinkedIn Top Companies list in Cincinnati

title: Sr. Analyst, GSS Accounting Operations
description:
Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is now seeking a Sr. Analyst, GSS Accounting Operations to join our team at WHR Argentina in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Role Overview

This role will be part of Global Shared Services based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The GSS Accounting Operations Sr. Analyst Will

  • Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial records by preparing and reviewing journal entries, performing key reconciliations, and supporting period‑end close activities.
  • Maintain the integrity of the general ledger by managing intercompany transactions, subledger reconciliations, fixed asset accounting, and payroll‑related entries.
  • Support audits, internal controls, and management inquiries by maintaining audit‑ready documentation and analyzing variances.
  • Contribute to process improvements and standardization initiatives that enhance efficiency, control, and reliability within Accounting Operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare and review routine and moderately complex journal entries in accordance with accounting policies, close schedules, and required supporting documentation.
  • Perform intercompany accounting activities, including preparing intercompany entries, supporting eliminations, reconciling balances, and investigating variances.
  • Execute and support corporate and overhead allocations by validating allocation inputs, posting entries, and reconciling allocated balances.
  • Prepare and maintain fixed asset accounting activities, including asset setup review, capitalization review, depreciation calculations, transfers, retirements, and disposals in line with policy.
  • Perform subledger reconciliations (AP, AR, Payroll, Fixed Assets, etc.), analyze discrepancies, and drive timely resolution of identified variances.
  • Support month‑end, quarter‑end, and year‑end close processes, including preparing adjustments, reconciliations, supporting schedules, and close documentation.
  • Prepare and validate payroll accounting entries, including payroll journals, reconciliations, accruals, and timing adjustments.
  • Provide support for audits, internal controls, and management inquiries.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit‑ready documentation for accounting activities, reconciliations, and supporting analyses.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for process standardization, efficiency gains, and best‑practice implementation within Accounting Operations.

You’ll be successful if you have

  • Knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS accounting principles and end-to-end Record to Report processes.
  • Experience with journal entries, reconciliations, allocations, payroll accounting, and close activities.
  • Expertise in fixed asset accounting including capitalization, depreciation, impairments, and disposals.
  • Ability to analyze complex variances, identify root causes, and propose corrective actions.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) in multi‑entity environments.
  • Understanding of accounting controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing deadlines, and manage critical period‑end activities.
  • Knowledge of Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with regional and global stakeholders.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to support cross‑regional operations.

Required Qualifications/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience in Accounting, R2R, or Shared Services operations.
  • Strong experience preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciliations, payroll accounting, and close processes.
  • Strong experience with fixed asset accounting.
  • Experience in multi‑entity and/or shared services environments is preferred.
  • Prior experience supporting audits and internal controls is preferred.
  • Analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.

WHR Argentina, Maipu 1300 piso 18, Buenos Aires, Argentina C1006ACT

Employment Status

Full‑time

Você fará parte de um time que busca soluções inovadoras em automação e inteligência artificial colocando a empresa em patamares de excelência. Dentro de um ambiente com autonomia e oportunidades de crescimento, que vive a cultura ágil integrada ao modelo de gestão!

Claude (Anthropic)

title: Officer, Security_FR
description:
Résumé du Poste

Sous la direction du/de la superviseur(se), l'objectif de ce poste est de suivre le contexte de la sécurité du pays dans les zones d'intervention d'IMC et d'aider à maintenir un environnement sûr et sécurisé pour les employés, les visiteurs, les locaux et les biens d'IMC, ainsi que d’entretenir une communication régulière avec le personnel pendant les déplacements sur le terrain.

Pour mener à bien ce travail, une personne doit être capable de remplir chaque fonction essentielle avec ou sans aménagements raisonnables.

Principales Tâches et Responsabilités

  • Soutenir la mise en œuvre des procédures opérationnelles standard (POS) et des protocoles et procédures de sécurité dans les missions nationales.
  • Recueillir, rassembler et analyser régulièrement l’ensemble des informations relatives à la sûreté et à la sécurité, selon les besoins.
  • Réaliser une cartographie des incidents/acteurs et produire des rapports pertinents, le cas échéant.
  • Assister l'équipe de la flotte dans la planification des mouvements, soutenir la conduite des formations et des programmes de sécurité et de sûreté/route pour les chauffeurs, l'équipe de la flotte, les partenaires et les autres parties prenantes du programme.
  • Former et encadrer les agents de sécurité et les chauffeurs.
  • Effectuer des évaluations contextuelles périodiques et occasionnelles de l'approvisionnement et des services (S&S) sur le terrain et rédiger des rapports.
  • Effectuer ou participer aux enquêtes sur les incidents.
  • Suivre et enregistrer l’ensemble des déplacements du personnel d’IMC sur le terrain.
  • Réagir aux incidents de sécurité pertinents en rassemblant des informations et en informant le/la superviseur(se), le cas échéant.
  • Procéder à des évaluations continues des équipements (y compris les véhicules) et des biens de l'organisation afin de s'assurer que les conditions minimales de sécurité sont remplies. Prévenir les pertes et les dégâts en signalant les irrégularités et en informant les contrevenants de la politique et des procédures.
  • Effectuer des inspections mensuelles en matière de santé et de sécurité telles que les extincteurs, les détecteurs de fumée/incendie et l'inspection des installations d'IMC.
  • Inventorier régulièrement et stocker si nécessaire les kits d'hibernation, les kits de premiers secours, les kits de sécurité pour les véhicules, les gadgets de communication ; s'assurer que le personnel a connaissance du contenu des kits et de comment et quand les utiliser.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de terrain d'IMC afin de s’assurer que tous les incidents et accidents fassent l'objet d'un rapport d'incident écrit officiel.
  • Prendre les mesures appropriées pour sécuriser les locaux, le personnel, les actifs et les biens d'IMC en surveillant et en contrôlant régulièrement les dispositifs de sécurité existants d'IMC.
  • Assurer la liaison avec d'autres acteurs humanitaires sur le terrain afin d'obtenir des informations sur la situation en matière de sûreté et de sécurité.
  • Analyser et mettre à jour régulièrement les vulnérabilités d'IMC dans ses zones d'intervention.
  • Soutenir l'équipe du service de sécurité en participant à la révision de la sécurité du pays et à d'autres POS.

Effectuer les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées. Les fonctions et responsabilités énumérées dans le présent document sont représentatives de la nature et du volume du travail assigné et ne sont pas nécessairement exhaustives.

Qualifications Minimales

  • En règle générale, diplôme de niveau supérieur en sciences humaines ou en sciences et gestion de la sécurité.
  • Expérience pertinente d'au moins un ou deux ans.
  • Forte attitude d'apprentissage et capacité à apprendre et développer des compétences techniques et professionnelles.
  • Sensibilité culturelle très développée et capacité à travailler dans un environnement international diversifié.
  • Volonté de travailler et d’effectuer des déplacements dans des environnements souvent difficiles et peu sûrs.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et d'autres langues locales.
  • Capacité à comprendre les sujets liés à la sécurité tels que l'évaluation des menaces/risques, la gestion de la sécurité et la sensibilisation à la sécurité physique personnelle et organisationnelle.
  • Expérience ou capacité avérée à travailler efficacement dans des environnements et situations de sécurité complexes, avec une bonne compréhension du conflit dans le nord-est.

Job Summary

At the direction of the supervisor, the purpose of this role is to follow up the country security context in IMC areas of intervention and assists in maintaining a safe and secure environment for IMC employees and visitors, premises, and assets as well as maintaining regular communication with staff during field movement.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function with or without reasonable accommodation.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities

  • Supports the implementing of SOPs and security protocols and procedures in country mission.
  • Regular collection, collation, and analysis of all Safety and Security information as required.
  • Carry out Incident/actor mapping and produce relevant reports as required.
  • Assist the Fleet team in Movement Planning support the conduct of Safety and Security/Road, Safety trainings and programs for program drivers/fleet team/partners/other program stakeholders.
  • Trains and mentor security guards and drivers.
  • Carry out periodic and occasioned S&S field contextual assessments and generate reports.
  • Carry out/support incidents investigations.
  • Track and record all IMC Staff field movements.
  • Respond to relevant security incidents with information gathering and inform supervisor as required.
  • Undertake continual assessments of equipment (including vehicles) and organizational assets to ensure that minimal conditions for security are met. Prevent loss and damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policy and procedures.
  • Conduct monthly health and safety inspections such as fire extinguishers, smoke/fire detectors and inspection of IMC facilities.
  • Regularly inventory and stock as necessary hibernation kits, first aid kits, and vehicle safety kits, communication gadgets; ensure that staff know what is in the kits and how and when to use them.
  • Work closely with IMC field teams to ensure all incidents and accidents are followed up with an official written Incident Report.
  • Take appropriate measures to secure IMC premises, personnel, assets, and properties by regularly monitoring and controlling IMC existing security set-up.
  • Liaise with other humanitarian actors in the field to obtain information on the safety and security situation.
  • Regularly analyze and update IMC’s vulnerabilities in its areas of intervention.
  • Supports the Security department team by participating during country security revision and other SOPs.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed in this document are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily all inclusive.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically, degree level qualifications in any of humanities or sciences and Security management.
  • At least one- or two-years’ relevant experience.
  • Strong learning attitude and capacity for learning and development of technical and professional skills.
  • Highly developed cultural awareness and ability to work well in an internationally diverse environment.
  • A willingness to work and travel in often difficult and insecure environments.
  • Fluency in English and other local languages.
  • Ability to comprehend security related subjects such as threat/risk assessment, security management, and personal and organizational physical security awareness.
  • Proven experience or ability of working effectively in complex security environments and situations with an articulate understanding of the conflict in northeast.

title: Principal Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Principal Engineer

Terrific Live is a social commerce platform that helps retailers and eCommerce brands grow revenue through live, interactive, social‑native shopping experiences on their own websites. Our platform connects audiences and shop presenters in real time — streaming to global brands, retailers, and media groups across Latin America, Europe, and Israel — and turns live moments into measurable sales.

We’re hiring a Principal Engineer to set the technical direction of the platform, raise the engineering bar, and help us scale a 24/7, high‑availability, AI‑powered product to the next order of magnitude.

Role

The Principal Engineer is our most senior individual contributor—a force‑multiplier across the entire engineering organization. You’ll own architecture and technical strategy for Terrific’s platform end‑to‑end: real‑time live video commerce, AI/ML‑driven personalization, commerce integrations, data infrastructure, and everything in between. You’ll stay deeply hands‑on—writing code, reviewing designs, and shipping critical systems—while also shaping how the team builds: standards, patterns, performance, and reliability. You’ll partner closely with the R&D managers, Product manager, and Design on the hardest, highest‑leverage problems.

Technical Leadership

  • Own the end‑to‑end architecture of the Terrific platform across backend, frontend, data, AI, and real‑time systems.
  • Drive engineering standards—code quality, testing, observability, security, and operational excellence—and raise the bar across the team.
  • Mentor engineers; grow the technical depth of the organization.
  • Design and implement new services and features end‑to‑end, from database to UI, with high performance and responsiveness.
  • Build rapid prototype features A to Z.
  • Tackle the highest‑risk, highest‑impact problems personally—live video reliability, real‑time engagement, commerce integrations, and AI‑powered experiences.
  • Evolve our stack thoughtfully: React, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, GCP, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.
  • Architect for global, 24/7 live operation—uptime, latency, cost, and graceful degradation during peak live events.
  • Build for B2B2C scale: systems that serve enterprise customers (brands, retailers, broadcasters) and their consumer audiences across multiple regions and languages.
  • Partner with Product and Data on experimentation infrastructure so every meaningful change can be A/B tested and measured.
  • Partner with Product and Design from concept through launch, taking full ownership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Represent engineering with strategic customers and partners on deep technical topics; translate customer reality into architectural decisions.
  • Make the whole team better—through design reviews, technical writing, mentorship, and hiring.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands‑on software engineering experience, with a track record of leading at staff/principal level at high‑scale products.
  • Expert‑level Node.js and TypeScript; strong frontend experience in React and/or Angular (both a significant plus).
  • Deep experience designing and operating distributed, real‑time systems in production, 24/7, under load.
  • Strong data engineering instincts: SQL/NoSQL, event‑driven architectures, and analytical stores (BigQuery or equivalent).
  • Hands‑on experience building or shipping AI/ML‑powered features in production—personalization, recommendations, search, or generative AI.
  • Experience on GCP (Firebase, Cloud Functions, Firestore, Realtime Database, Pub/Sub) is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce, and/or live video/streaming infrastructure, is a plus.
  • Excellent judgment on trade‑offs between scope, speed, performance, and UX; strong product intuition.
  • Clear, calm communicator: writes well, pushes back thoughtfully, and makes the people around them more effective.

Benefits

  • Principal‑level ownership of the platform that defines live, shoppable media.
  • Real, global scale—top brands, retailers, and broadcasters, running 24/7 across LatAm, Europe, and Israel.
  • A modern stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Angular, GCP, Firebase, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) with the autonomy to evolve it.
  • A tight, senior team where product, design, data, and engineering ship together.

Join to apply for the Developer Relations Engineer role at Canonical

As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises.
We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities.
A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation.
To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.
Location : we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones
What your day will look like
In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might:

  • take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise
  • maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more
  • work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches
  • help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified
  • contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there
  • work on technical articles, presentations or workshops
  • identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide
  • present at conferences, meetups or technical events
What we are looking for in you
A strong candidate
  • is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software
  • has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux
  • has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers)
  • understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem
  • has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation
  • is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter

A NIP do Brasil é uma empresa de engenharia consultiva focada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades. Realizar levantamentos técnicos em campo em locais previamente definidos, assegurando a coleta de dados confiáveis, evidências georreferenciadas e a validação das condições reais para atendimento de solicitações de energia elétrica.   • Cumprir metas operacionais de produtividade;
  • Assegurar a qualidade e integridade das informações coletadas para validação;
  • Atuar conforme normas de segurança, especialmente em atividades com risco elétrico;
  • Utilizar corretamente os EPI’s e seguir as diretrizes de segurança do trabalho.

Compromisso com a Diversidade

A NIP do Brasil valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas. Todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente onde todos possam prosperar.

Le ou la responsable, RH et administration sur site national fournit un soutien en matière de ressources humaines et d'administration au service des RH. Il/elle sera chargé(e) de la supervision opérationnelle des principales fonctions RH, notamment l'acquisition et la gestion des talents, les relations avec le personnel et le soutien administratif, ainsi que le soutien à la gestion des performances, etc. Pour mener à bien ce travail, une personne doit être capable de remplir chaque fonction essentielle avec ou sans aménagements raisonnables.

Job Summary

The Officer, Country HR and Admin provides Human Resource and Administrative support for the HR department. He/she will be responsible for HR operational oversight of key HR functions including Talent Acquisition and management, Staff Relations and Administration support, and Performance Management support etc. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function with or without reasonable accommodation.

HR AND ADMINISTRATION MANAGEMENT

  • Participate in reviewing national staff policies and recommend changes/additions/deletions to the HR & Administration Manager.
  • Provide support to program and operations staff in interpretation of HR policies and procedures and provide technical support on HR issues, as directed by supervisor.
  • Work with HR & Administration Management on implementation of strategic planning of the department.
  • Conduct regular field travel to project offices to ensure proper implementation of human resources procedures and assist/support managers in their needs.
  • Maintains compensation databases and ensures employment records are properly maintained in the HR systems (CostPoint, Local HR system).
  • Facilitate the recruitment process and advise the hiring manager on each recruitment stage and prepare regular recruitment tracking reports.
  • Ensure that the recruitment process is fair and transparent and in line with IMC HR policies and procedures.
  • Ensure proper orientation for all new staff; collaborate and coordinate with other departments to provide an engaging and welcoming orientation.
  • Advise and facilitate employee separation process and maintain separation documents in employee file.
  • Assist in updating organograms, maintaining contact lists, and information flow lines regularly.
  • Assist in preparation of employee contracts, and other mandatory documents are signed and filed.
  • Assist in writing personnel letters as required (transfer, promotion, increment, acceptance of resignation and others).
  • Assist in preparation of separation / terminal benefits.
  • Assist HR Management to do periodic turnover analysis.
  • Coordinate travel of international staff (itinerary, ticketing).
  • Ensure that all the personnel files are kept in safe custody and are updated on a regular basis. Also, ensure that the required documents are uploaded on shared cloud system (Office 365).
  • Support HR Management to ensure that performance reviews are processed timely and filed.
  • Supports country program supervisors and staff in the goal setting, end of probation or annual performance reviews ensuring proper documentation of performance appraisals.
  • Supports country program supervisors to identify training needs or performance gaps of staff.
  • Support the audit and compliance process and provide the documentation after reviewed by HR Management.
  • In collaboration with supervisor, liaise with the Certified Public Accountant for the NSSF and Income tax payment schedules.
  • Perform other related duties as requested.

ADMIN SUPPORT

  • Organize visa applications/ immigration clearance procedures for international staff as necessary.
  • Ensure that office and Guesthouse supplies are available and replenished timely.
  • Track office and Guesthouse utility bills and lease agreements to ensure timely payments and renewals.
  • Ensure that facility staff are well coordinated and effectively performing their roles.
  • Manage utilization of office space and bookings for accommodation to IMC Guesthouse.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed in this document are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily all inclusive.

  • Une expérience préalable auprès d'International Medical Corps est un atout.
  • Connaissance du droit du travail local.
  • Une expérience des systèmes d'information des ressources humaines serait un atout supplémentaire.
  • Connaissance des principes et procédures en matière de recrutement, de sélection, de formation, de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux du personnel, de conception des postes, de relations de travail et de négociation, ainsi que des systèmes d'information des ressources humaines.

  • Bonnes compétences en gestion des conflits.

  • Capacité à maintenir la confidentialité et à encourager la confiance et le respect.

  • Flexible, capable de respecter les délais et de travailler sous pression.
  • Polyvalent(e).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically, a bachelor's degree in related area. A degree in HR management is preferable. An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.
  • Typically, 3+ years’ experience as a HR generalist.
  • Previous experience with International Medical Corps is a plus.
  • Knowledge of local labor laws.

  • Knowledge of principles and procedures for staff recruitment, selection, training, compensation and benefits, job design, labor relations and negotiation, and Human Resources Information Systems.
  • Knowledge and understanding of local employment standards.
  • Strong MS office and the ability to use technology to collaborate.
  • Good conflict management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent planning and organizing skills.
  • Ability to work effectively and collaborate with others.

description:

Responsabilidades Da Posição

  • Realizar inspeção visual nos veículos, identificando possíveis falhas elétricas em lâmpadas e lanternas, efetuando a substituição quando necessário.
  • Executar a leitura de códigos de falha por meio de scanner automotivo.
  • Instalar e desinstalar sistemas e componentes eletroeletrônicos, conectando cabos, testando o funcionamento de equipamentos e garantindo a correta operação de sistemas como rastreamento e aparelhos de mídia.
  • Realizar correções no sistema de ARLA 32, calibração da suspensão e recuperação de componentes eletrônicos.
  • Executar recondicionamento e conserto de alternadores, motores de partida e chaves magnéticas, efetuar troca de lentes de faróis, montagem de rastreadores, instalação e parametrização da parte elétrica dos veículos.
  • Montar chicotes elétricos e corrigir curtos-circuitos nas instalações elétricas, fazendo uso de multímetro.
  • Realizar diagnóstico com precisão.
  • Manter a limpeza e a organização das peças no setor, atuando sempre conforme as normas de segurança, meio ambiente e saúde, assegurando a qualidade nas instalações e manutenções eletroeletrônicas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Experiência profissional com elétrica automotiva de carro à diesel.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no horário da vaga de 21h às 06h.

Sobre a Empresa

Você irá trabalhar na Expresso Guanabara.

Nossa História: Em agosto de 1992 nasceu a Expresso Guanabara, uma empresa de transporte rodoviário de passageiros. Com sede em Fortaleza e com atuação de Norte ao Sul, nestes 31 anos de existência, a Empresa interliga as principais capitais e cidades do país, ofertando mais de 2000 opções de destinos aos passageiros. Com diversas categorias de serviço de alta qualidade, a Guanabara mantém uma frota de veículos novos, sintonizados com tecnologias de ponta em mecânica, design e conforto. Além do e-commerce e aplicativo, a Empresa possui um canal direto de atendimento ao cliente, por telefone e WhatsApp e conta com mais de 2500 agências, entre próprias e terceirizadas.

A Guanabara tem um forte compromisso social e ambiental a partir de diversos projetos de sustentabilidade, como o gerenciamento de resíduos sólidos, reutilização da água, dentre outros. A busca pela excelência técnica, o elevado grau de comprometimento com os funcionários e a qualidade dos serviços oferecida aos clientes renderam à Guanabara o título de melhor empresa de ônibus em 2022, no prêmio Maiores e Melhores do Transporte.

title: Gerente de Tributos Indiretos - São Paulo 1
description:
Overview

Oportunidade para Gerente de Tributos Indiretos para o escritório de São Paulo.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

Responsibilities

  • Liderar e participar de vários projetos de consultoria na área de VAT, oferecendo assistência na identificação de áreas de risco e oportunidades de planejamento sustentável em tributos em todas as etapas de incidência de impostos, ajudando os clientes a cumprir suas obrigações de compliance e seus objetivos de negócios;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com o cliente ao longo do ano. Estabelecer expectativas de valor a ser produzido como resultado;
  • Manter-se informado/a sobre os desenvolvimentos econômicos e corporativos gerais e seu impacto para o cliente;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, incentivando-as a refletir e a assumir responsabilidade por suas contribuições à equipe. Delegar trabalho de forma bem-sucedida, conduzindo revisões de desempenho de forma tempestiva e fornecer feedback/treinamento com relação ao desempenho apresentado;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa;
  • Manter relacionamentos de cooperação com outras equipes de trabalho;
  • Monitorar o progresso da equipe de trabalho com relação ao planejamento e fazer alterações quando necessário;
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio;
  • Ter um bom entendimento sobre a EY e suas linhas de serviço e avaliar/apresentar de forma ativa maneiras para a aplicação do conhecimento e dos serviços da empresa;
  • Desenvolver relacionamentos duradouros tanto dentro como fora da empresa.

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Gerente Tributário/a de Impostos Indiretos, você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar áreas de riscos, oportunidades de planejamento sustentável ao longo do ciclo de vida dos impostos indiretos e apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações de conformidade e metas de negócios em todo o mundo. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Conhecimento em Inglês;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS e ISS);
  • Habilidades de gestão de projetos;

Desejável

  • Experiência em projetos de compliance e/ou planejamento, análise e revisão de procedimentos fiscais, levantamento de créditos tributários, elaboração de relatórios e consultas sobre questões tributárias e fiscais e reestruturação de operações;
  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
  • Expertise em elaboração de propostas técnicas e desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

Benefícios

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas para as pessoas Pretas e Pardas e, como o Programa de Entry-level exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Survey Participants

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The role

We are looking for Study Participants from all professional backgrounds across Brazil to take part in academic and applied research studies for global businesses and educational faculties.

Whether you are just starting your career or are a seasoned expert, your perspective is valuable. We are actively seeking a diverse range of educational backgrounds, including:

  • No High School Diploma / High School Graduates
  • Trade School & Vocational Professionals (MBO)
  • Undergraduate & Master's Degree Holders (HBO/WO)
  • PhD Candidates & Doctoral Researchers

If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick 10- to 15-minute screening to assess your suitability. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a participant, where you’ll get paid to contribute to a wide range of projects.

Compensation

Researchers looking for your profile tend to pay up to $18/hr per study completed. While many tasks are short, you should be prepared for studies that require up to one hour of uninterrupted work.

What you’ll be doing in the role

As a participant, you will contribute to high-quality research outcomes by responding thoughtfully to various tasks, including:

  • AI Training & Evaluation: helping refine Large Language Models by ranking responses or providing creative prompts.
  • Behavioral Experiments: participating in decision-making tasks and cognitive games.
  • User Research: providing feedback on new software, apps, or product concepts.
  • Academic Studies: assisting university researchers in fields like psychology, economics, and sociology.
  • Interviews: engaging in one-on-one deep dives regarding your professional expertise or lived experience.
  • Surveys & Questionnaires: sharing your opinions on current events, consumer habits, or workplace culture.

What you’ll bring

  • Diverse Perspective: a track record of relevant experience, knowledge, or lived context (from entry-level roles to executive or academic positions).
  • Attention to Detail: the ability to remain focused and provide high-quality data for the duration of a study.
  • Technical Setup: a reliable, fast internet connection and access to a desktop or laptop computer.
  • Financial Readiness: a PayPal account to receive payments and a willingness to self-declare earnings as a self-employed participant.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We’ve built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won’t come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

What You'll Be Working On (Your Impact):

  • Design, build, and maintain a centralized repository of CLAUDE.md project context files across all Coinme repositories, ensuring Claude Code understands our architecture, coding standards, compliance requirements, and domain patterns out of the box
  • Create custom Claude Code slash commands, hooks, and workflows tailored to Coinme's stack—including compliance‑aware code generation, automated test scaffolding, and review automation for our CQRS/Event Sourcing architecture
  • Implement and manage the GitLab CI/CD integration for Claude Code, enabling automated merge request creation from issues, AI‑assisted code review in pipelines, and commit attribution across all engineering teams
  • Build and deliver structured training programs to close adoption gaps across the engineering org, with a focus on the highest‑leverage skills: headless/CI‑CD workflows, hooks and commands, and test‑driven development with Claude Code
  • Monitor engineering adoption metrics via the Claude Enterprise Analytics API, identify engineers and teams that are underutilizing the tool, and design targeted interventions to accelerate their productivity
  • Develop and maintain a living playbook of best practices, prompt patterns, and workflow recipes that codify what Coinme's top Claude Code users (power users generating 5,000+ tool accepts) do differently
  • Partner with Engineering Leadership to define proficiency benchmarks, run competency assessments, and measure ROI of AI tooling investment across the organization
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging Claude Code capabilities—including MCP server integrations, multi‑file editing workflows, and agentic coding patterns as they become available
  • Work within and build tooling for our technology stack:
    • GitLab (repos, CI/CD pipelines, merge requests)

    • Claude Code CLI and VS Code extension
    • Claude Enterprise Analytics API
    • Java 17+ / Spring Boot / Reactive Java (understanding, not necessarily writing daily)
    • Kubernetes, Helm, Argo platform
    • Multi‑repo microservice architecture

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years of experience as a software engineer with hands‑on production coding experience

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and automation (GitLab CI preferred)
  • Strong understanding of Git workflows, code review processes, and merge request automation
  • Experience working with REST APIs for data integration and dashboard building
  • Comfort navigating and understanding large, multi‑repo codebases without necessarily being an expert in every language or framework
  • Excellent written communication — you'll be writing CLAUDE.md files, training docs, and playbooks that need to be clear enough for both humans and AI to understand
  • Self‑directed and proactive — this is a one‑person function where you set the agenda based on data and engineer feedback

Not Required, But Nice to Have:

title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.

This is a fully remote role.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.
  • Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.
  • Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.
  • Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.
  • Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.
  • Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.
  • Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.
  • Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.
  • Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.
  • AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.
  • Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.
  • Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus

  • Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.
  • Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).
  • Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.
  • Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.

Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances.
  • Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1.
  • Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions.
  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities.
  • An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

title: Finance Director - Brazil
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

The Finance Director is responsible for the end-to-end financial management of a regulated payment institution operating in Brazil with both traditional banking and digital asset (crypto) activities. The role combines the responsibilities of a CFO within a Banco Central do Brasil regulated payment institution with the operational and financial oversight required for a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP).

The Finance Director will oversee all financial, accounting, treasury, regulatory reporting, and operational finance functions while ensuring strict compliance with Brazilian banking regulations and emerging crypto regulatory frameworks. The role requires a hands‑on and operational leader who is deeply involved in daily financial operations, payment flows, fiat and crypto liquidity management, and the integrity of financial reporting across both traditional and blockchain-based systems.

This position acts as a key member of the executive leadership team, partnering with the local General Manager, regulators, banking partners, and internal operational teams to ensure the institution operates with strong financial discipline, transparency, and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the company’s financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management processes.
  • Oversee controllership, accounting, and financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and regulatory standards.
  • Act as the primary financial counterpart for regulators, ensuring compliance with financial and prudential reporting requirements established by the Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) and other applicable authorities.
  • Lead treasury, liquidity management, cash positioning, and banking relationships, ensuring the institution maintains financial resilience and operational stability.
  • Oversee the financial governance of fiat payment operations, including key payment infrastructure such as PIX, bank transfers, payment processors, and banking partners, ensuring appropriate reconciliation control.
  • Oversee financial operations related to digital assets, including wallets, custodial balances, blockchain reconciliations, and crypto treasury activities, ensuring accurate accounting treatment, visibility over on‑chain transactions, and proper integration into financial reporting and internal controls.
  • Monitor capital adequacy, balance sheet efficiency, and financial performance to support both growth and regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor tax compliance and possess strong knowledge of tax legislation to validate tax obligations and support effective tax planning strategies.
  • Strengthen internal controls, financial governance, and audit readiness across the finance function.
  • Partner closely with Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, Product, and Engineering to ensure the company’s growth and innovation agenda is supported by strong financial foundations and sound governance.

Requirements:

  • BA/BS in Finance or Accounting (Master/MBA, CMA or CPA preferred)
  • Extensive experience serving as a CFO, Finance Director, or senior finance executive within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payments company, or digital asset platform. Experience managing finance functions in regulated environments is essential.
  • Expertise in financial reporting under Brazilian accounting standards and IFRS, including experience managing complex financial reporting environments that involve high transaction volumes and multiple asset classes.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks applicable to financial institutions regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil, including regulatory reporting requirements, capital adequacy expectations, and financial governance standards.
  • Understanding of fiat payment systems including bank transfers, payment processors, and domestic payment networks such as PIX, along with the reconciliation and financial reporting requirements associated with these systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in highly operational environments, with a self‑starter mentality and hands‑on involvement in payment flows, treasury movements, transaction reconciliations, and day‑to‑day financial processes.
  • Ability to work in an unstructured environment, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple assignments simultaneously, and provide clarity and structure
  • Fluent writing and speaking in English and Portuguese required

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Survey Participants

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The role

We are looking for Study Participants from all professional backgrounds across Brazil to take part in academic and applied research studies for global businesses and educational faculties.

Whether you are just starting your career or are a seasoned expert, your perspective is valuable. We are actively seeking a diverse range of educational backgrounds, including:

  • No High School Diploma / High School Graduates
  • Trade School & Vocational Professionals (MBO)
  • Undergraduate & Master's Degree Holders (HBO/WO)
  • PhD Candidates & Doctoral Researchers

If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick 10- to 15-minute screening to assess your suitability. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a participant, where you’ll get paid to contribute to a wide range of projects.

Compensation

Researchers looking for your profile tend to pay up to $18/hr per study completed. While many tasks are short, you should be prepared for studies that require up to one hour of uninterrupted work.

What you’ll be doing in the role

As a participant, you will contribute to high-quality research outcomes by responding thoughtfully to various tasks, including:

  • AI Training & Evaluation: helping refine Large Language Models by ranking responses or providing creative prompts.
  • Behavioral Experiments: participating in decision-making tasks and cognitive games.
  • User Research: providing feedback on new software, apps, or product concepts.
  • Academic Studies: assisting university researchers in fields like psychology, economics, and sociology.
  • Interviews: engaging in one-on-one deep dives regarding your professional expertise or lived experience.
  • Surveys & Questionnaires: sharing your opinions on current events, consumer habits, or workplace culture.

What you’ll bring

  • Diverse Perspective: a track record of relevant experience, knowledge, or lived context (from entry-level roles to executive or academic positions).
  • Attention to Detail: the ability to remain focused and provide high-quality data for the duration of a study.
  • Technical Setup: a reliable, fast internet connection and access to a desktop or laptop computer.
  • Financial Readiness: a PayPal account to receive payments and a willingness to self-declare earnings as a self-employed participant.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We’ve built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won’t come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

São Paulo - SP

Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga se sentem que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, queremos te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Aqui, valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências.

Essa posição está associada à capacidade do Instituto Kunumi de acessar e estruturar recursos de fomento, atuando na interface entre conformidade institucional e execução de projetos, com vistas a apoiar a sustentabilidade do Instituto.

Trata-se de um papel que conecta instrumentos de financiamento à viabilização de iniciativas estratégicas, assegurando que projetos se convertam em entregas consistentes e com impacto no ecossistema de pesquisa e inovação.

Esse propósito se traduz, na prática, nos seguintes Jobs to Be Done:

Estruturar a participação do Instituto em oportunidades de fomento: atuar na identificação, interpretação e articulação de editais, garantindo sua conversão em iniciativas alinhadas à estratégia institucional.

Traduzir exigências de fomento em propostas estruturadas: organizar projetos e parcerias em propostas competitivas e institucionalmente consistentes.

Conduzir a formalização e conformidade de projetos financiados: assegurar a correta aplicação de instrumentos jurídicos e administrativos, garantindo segurança institucional ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto.

Sustentar a execução de projetos com previsibilidade e controle: acompanhar a dimensão administrativa dos projetos, garantindo alinhamento com prazos, regras e exigências dos financiadores.

Assegurar a integridade dos processos de acompanhamento e prestação de contas: estruturar e conduzir relatórios e prestações de contas com qualidade e aderência normativa com atividades como: gestão, monitoramento e controle administrativo, financeiro e contábil de acordo com as regras dos respectivos editais, elaboração de relatórios periódicos, organização de evidências comprobatórias da realização dos projetos (recibos, notas fiscais, fotos, vídeos).

Estruturar fluxos institucionais de fomento: consolidar processos, rotinas e práticas que ampliem a eficiência operacional e a capacidade de escala do Instituto e de seus COLABs.

O que é esperado de você

Vivência prática comprovada em ambientes de fomento à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação.

Domínio na leitura e interpretação de editais, chamadas públicas e legislações correlatas, e capacidade de elaboração de textos complexos de projetos (definição de escopo, justificativa e objetivos).

Experiência na gestão administrativo-financeira de recursos incentivados, públicos e privados, e familiaridade com os fluxos, dinâmicas institucionais e aspectos jurídicos da gestão de projetos financiados.

Alta capacidade de organização, atenção rigorosa a detalhes e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos cronogramas simultaneamente.

Habilidade de interlocução com diferentes públicos (pesquisadores, jurídico, administrativo e parceiros externos).

  • Inglês fluente e flexibilidade para viagens conforme necessidade dos projetos.

O que é considerado um diferencial

Trajetória prévia em agências de fomento, fundações de apoio ou instituições de fomento à pesquisa.

Vivência em ICTs (Institutos de Ciência e Tecnologia), ambientes de inovação ou projetos colaborativos entre a academia e o setor privado.

Familiaridade prática com as plataformas e normativas de órgãos específicos, como CNPq, FINEP e CAPES.

Compreensão aprofundada sobre a lógica dos instrumentos de financiamento e seus desdobramentos institucionais e conhecimento amplo do ecossistema de inovação, facilitando a leitura de cenários complexos e diversificados.

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

  • Cultura dinâmica, diversa e focada no crescimento conjunto
  • Trabalho em ambiente remoto com horário flexível
  • Suporte home-office (ajuda de custo, cadeira, headphones, laptop, entre outros)

SOBRE O PROCESSO

Depois de enviar sua inscrição, você receberá um email de confirmação. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove a criatividade e acelera resultados positivos, portanto, consideramos todos os candidatos não somente pela qualificação técnica, mas também por como nos complementam como grupo.

NASF - As Equipes do NASF atuam de forma integrada às Equipes da Estratégia Saúde da Família de forma transversal e compartilhada, por meio de diversas atividades como reuniões de equipe, discussão de casos, visitas domiciliares, ações coletivas e individuais compartilhadas e articulação territorial.

CAPS - O CAPS é um serviço destinado a acolher e acompanhar pacientes com transtornos mentais graves, através de atendimento integral que visa estimular e apoiar os usuários em suas iniciativas de busca da autonomia, acesso ao trabalho, lazer, exercício dos direitos civis e fortalecimento dos laços familiares e comunitários.

CER - Os Centros Especializados em Reabilitação são unidades voltadas para o atendimento especializado de pessoas com deficiência que necessitam de reabilitação, com o objetivo de desenvolver seu potencial físico e psicossocial. O diagnóstico, a avaliação, a orientação e a estimulação dos usuários são responsabilidade da equipe multiprofissional.

UBS - Unidades Básicas de Saúde (UBS) são serviços que compõem a Rede de Atenção Básica de Saúde, caracterizados pelo alto nível de capilaridade e pela oferta de serviços de saúde com maior proximidade dos usuários. Suas atividades estão voltadas para a promoção , proteção , recuperação da saúde e prevenção de doenças, de forma individual ou coletiva, articulada com outros serviços da Rede de Saúde e intersetorial.

EMAD - Constituídas por médicos, enfermeiros, técnicos de enfermagem e fisioterapeutas. O objetivo é levar o atendimento médico às casas de pessoas com necessidade de reabilitação motora, idosos, pacientes crônicos sem agravamento ou em situação pós-cirúrgica.

APD - O Programa tem como objetivo apoiar pessoas com deficiência intelectual e sua família em sua inserção na sociedade e na busca por autonomia. O serviço se dá por meio de visitas domiciliares e do acompanhamento e da supervisão em atividades cotidianas, como idas ao mercado e passeios em parques, praças e outros locais de convivência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Abordar os distúrbios da comunicação, atuando na avaliação, tratamento e acompanhamento das alterações da audição, voz, linguagem oral e escrita, motricidade oral. Realizar diagnóstico situacional do sujeito e/ou núcleo familiar, grupos ou território, considerando fatores de risco e proteção das condições sociais e de saúde, com o objetivo de propor estratégias de intervenção, baseadas na promoção, prevenção e recuperação em todos os ciclos de vida. Participar de discussão de caso, atividades de matriciamento e elaboração de projetos terapêuticos singulares. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde e intersetorial, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

  • Renova: Com foco em mobilidade e eficiência logística, a Renova atua na aquisição de veículos novos para a JBS e na comercialização de caminhões e carretas seminovas, unindo qualidade, confiança e agilidade no transporte.

description:
Overview

Faça parte do nosso time! O Grupo Med4U, uma holding reconhecida por sua excelência em serviços de saúde, está em busca de talentos para compor seu quadro de colaboradores, com foco na inclusão de pessoas com deficiência (PCD). Como parte do Grupo Med4U, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir para instituições renomadas como o Instituto de Oncologia do Paraná - IOP, o Laboratório Mantis, Oncoville, IOP Educa e Valencis Hospice, cada um desempenhando um papel fundamental no cuidado e na pesquisa em saúde. Estamos empenhados em promover um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde cada indivíduo é valorizado pelo que é e pelo que pode oferecer. Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência em busca de oportunidades para desenvolver todo o seu potencial, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

  • Ser uma pessoa com deficiência (PCD)
  • Desejável experiência na área da saúde
  • Será diferencial conhecimento no Sistema Tasy
  • Paixão pelo setor de saúde e disposição para aprender e crescer

Benefícios

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale transporte
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed
  • Convênio com farmácia Panvel
  • Convênio odontológico Dentaluni
  • Convênios com Instituições de Ensino Superior
  • Seguro de vida
  • Auxílio funeral
  • Gympass
  • Ginástica laboral
  • Conexa Saúde - Teleconsultas com psicólogos e nutricionistas gratuitas
  • Dia de Cuidar de Mim
  • Dia da fruta
  • Auxílio educação
  • Mimos especiais em datas comemorativas

Envie seu currículo e junte-se a nós nessa jornada de cuidado e excelência! Junte-se ao Grupo Med4U e faça a diferença na vida das pessoas todos os dias!
